title: NEXT-WORD PROBABILITY

intro.headline: Guess the model's next-token distribution
intro.body: Same predict-then-verify engine, no attention involved. The model has scored every candidate with a raw logit. Guess the probabilities it will produce, then see the softmax.

context: The cat sat on the ___
insight: You scored {score}/100. The model's top token is {top} at {topP}. Logits are unbounded scores, not probabilities — softmax is what turns them into a distribution that sums to 1. It converts additive score gaps into multiplicative odds: the 0.9 logit gap between the top two candidates is exactly a 2.46× probability ratio, because e0.9 = 2.46. Raising the temperature shrinks every gap toward uniform; lowering it sharpens toward always picking the argmax.
